mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO visit_log (visit_date, visitor_key, ip, user_agent) VALUES (#{visitDate}, #{visitorKey}, #{ip}, #{userAgent})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visit_log WHERE visit_date = #{visitDate}
SELECT visit_date AS visitDate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM visit_log WHERE visit_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY visit_date ORDER BY visit_date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO page_view_daily (view_date, path, view_count) VALUES (#{viewDate}, #{path}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE view_count = view_count + 1
mapper.select: SELECT path, view_count AS viewCount FROM page_view_daily WHERE view_date = #{viewDate} ORDER BY view_count DESC, path ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(view_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS viewDate, SUM(view_count) AS viewCount FROM page_view_daily WHERE view_date >= #{startDate, jdbcType=DATE} AND view_date <= #{endDate, jdbcType=DATE} GROUP BY view_date ORDER BY view_date ASC
